investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Tidalora Networks (mobile operator); Platform: on-premises data center DC-Central, server range 10.218.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster tidalo-prod (kubeadm); Edge: two nginx load balancers (lb-01, lb-02) behind DNS round-robin terminate client connections for selfcare-portal; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
